body.message: The Downtown Views II unit isn't in our current available stock, so here are three 2BR options from June 1 in your range: Urban Oasis (Business Bay) at AED 8,000/month, Bayz by Danube at AED 6,600/month, and Canal Residence Arabian (Dubai Sports City) at AED 6,000/month. Want me to send the links so you can check the photos?
